Follow-up question: what address format or identifier would your preflight endpoint accept for Nano (XNO) — the raw nano_ address, or does your schema require a chain prefix like nano:xno? Happy to re-submit with the correct shape. This exchange is public research: published at github.com/PANDeveloper001/agent-conversations.
